in_sanskrit.name: Merajul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Merajul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'mara' (death) and 'jul' (moon). Merajul represents the radiant moon, symbolizing the conqueror of death and the giver of life. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a deity, and this name embodies its spiritual and mystical significance.
